name: l2l-converter
description: L2L — Local file converter. Batch-convert images, video, audio and documents. 100% local & private.
author: Memoli08

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "next dev --webpack" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 node scripts/launch.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node scripts/launch.js test/run-in-electron.js
scripts.test:matrix: npm run build:electron && node scripts/launch.js test/matrix-test.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux && npm run checksums
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run checksums
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && npm run checksums
